stories.title: CISA Adds Critical Microarchitectural Execution Flaw to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
stories.summary: Federal agencies must patch an exploited speculative execution leak affecting enterprise hardware within three weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: Active exploitation signals widespread scanning and threat actor weaponization across shared cloud infrastructure.

stories.title: LLVM 21 Introduces Automated Constant-Time Cryptographic Verification Passes
stories.summary: The upstream compiler infrastructure merges backend flags designed to prevent variable-time instruction latency leaks in crypto implementations.
stories.why_it_matters: Mitigates side-channel timing attacks at compile time without manual inline assembly workarounds.
